// Stands in for "dart test" / "flutter test" in the tests of
// `test_gates mutation`. Kept as .txt so that it is not analyzed or formatted
// with the package; the tests copy it into a temporary directory and run it
// there.
//
// Usage: dart fake_test.dart [options of the test runner] <test file>...
//
// A "test file" says what it checks in comments, one rule per line:
//
//   // gate: lib/a.dart            the file under test
//   // expect: a + 1               the gate must contain this text, or the
//                                  run fails (exit 1): the mutant is killed
//   // compile-error-if: a / 1     with this text in the gate the run fails
//                                  the way a compile error does
//   // hang-if: a * 1              with this text in the gate the run never
//                                  ends; its pid is written to "started"
//   // fail                        the run fails whatever the gate holds
//
// Every run appends its arguments to "runs.log".
import 'dart:io';

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments) async {
  File('runs.log').writeAsStringSync(
    '${arguments.join(' ')}\n',
    mode: FileMode.append,
  );
  for (final spec in arguments.where((arg) => arg.endsWith('_test.dart'))) {
    final rules = [
      for (final line in File(spec).readAsLinesSync())
        if (line.startsWith('// ')) line.substring(3),
    ];
    String? value(String rule, String name) =>
        rule.startsWith('$name: ') ? rule.substring(name.length + 2) : null;
    final gatePath = rules.map((rule) => value(rule, 'gate')).nonNulls.first;
    final gate = File(gatePath).readAsStringSync();
    for (final rule in rules) {
      if (rule == 'fail') {
        stdout.writeln('00:00 +0 -1: Some tests failed.');
        exit(1);
      }
      final hang = value(rule, 'hang-if');
      if (hang != null && gate.contains(hang)) {
        File('started').writeAsStringSync('$pid');
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(hours: 1));
      }
      final broken = value(rule, 'compile-error-if');
      if (broken != null && gate.contains(broken)) {
        stderr.writeln("$gatePath:1:1: Error: A value of type 'x' can't be y.");
        exit(1);
      }
      final expected = value(rule, 'expect');
      if (expected != null && !gate.contains(expected)) {
        stdout.writeln('Expected: $expected');
        stdout.writeln('00:00 +0 -1: Some tests failed.');
        exit(1);
      }
    }
  }
  stdout.writeln('00:00 +1: All tests passed!');
}
